design_note: Prompts are for silent holding. The app should not require saving, journaling or mood tracking.

C01: What is the simplest anchor available to you right now: breath, sound, touch or sight?
What can wait until your body has had one quieter minute?
C02: Where do you feel distance from Source, and what longing remains alive there?
What name for the Divine feels honest today?
C03: What do you know quietly that you have been trying to prove loudly?
What would inner knowing feel like if it did not need certainty?
C04: What value can guide the next step before the whole answer is clear?
What pressure can be set aside so wisdom can speak plainly?
C05: What ordinary boundary would help you feel more grounded today?
What is real and near enough to notice in this room?
C06: What burden has already said what it needed to say?
What would release look like if it did not shame what you have carried?
C07: Where are you treating rest as something that must be earned?
What part of you needs restoration rather than more effort?
C08: What small brave action is actually yours to take?
What kind of courage fits this moment without becoming force?
C09: What kind of accompaniment would feel kind today?
Where can you ask for support without making your suffering your fault?
C10: What part of the loss needs to be spoken without being solved?
If comfort does not come today, what would help you be less alone?
C11: What are you ready to release, and what is not ready yet?
What boundary might be wiser than reconciliation right now?
C12: Where can love become one practical act rather than a feeling you force?
What dignity can you recognise in yourself and the other person?
C13: Who or what are you carrying in care today?
What concern can be held without pretending you control the outcome?
C14: What keeps returning as a quiet call?
What next step would honour purpose without demanding certainty?
C15: What wants to be made if it does not have to be impressive?
Where might creative work become participation rather than performance?
C16: What is enough for today, even if not everything is resolved?
What does gratitude look like without denying scarcity or fear?
C17: What would you say to yourself if worth did not need defending?
What self-critical thought can be held more gently?
C18: What is ending, and what deserves to be honoured before you move on?
What can accompany you across this threshold?
C19: What injustice is asking for a grounded, ethical response?
What action is yours, and what outcome is not yours to command?
C20: What unfinished thing can be left until morning?
What would help your body know the day is closing?
C21: What quality do you want to carry into the first part of the day?
What is one small act that would make this morning more faithful to your values?
C23: What pattern are you willing to see without naming yourself as broken?
What hidden part of you needs compassion before analysis?
C24: What does your body notice when you attend without trying to interpret?
Can this be symbolic attention rather than a claim you must prove?
C25: What becomes smaller when you remember the wideness of the world?
How can awe return you to care rather than escape?
C26: What inheritance are you grateful for, and what inheritance needs transforming?
Who helped make your life possible in ordinary, human ways?
C27: What joy can be received without needing to possess it?
